name: Intelligent Traffic Management
description: Dynamic traffic signal control using computer vision, IoT sensors, and AI/ML models to address urban congestion.
detail: Building at Vernovate with a target of reducing congestion by 30%. The reduction is a development target, not a measured deployment result. The ITMS project won the JEC Hackathon in February 2025.

caseStudy.problem: Urban congestion and fixed signal timing motivate adaptive traffic control.
caseStudy.contribution: Developing the traffic management system at Vernovate. Individual subsystem ownership is not yet documented.
caseStudy.approach: Computer vision and IoT sensor inputs support the proposed signal-control system.
caseStudy.outcome: JEC Hackathon winner, February 2025. A 30% congestion reduction is a development target.
caseStudy.limitations: No measured on-site congestion reduction is reported.
caseStudy.learning: Evaluation should compare the same traffic conditions against a fixed-timing baseline.
